method: Read section 5 of all 42 original PDFs, preserving incident order, participant identity and stated contact region. Original PDF text and AcroForm fields are archived with SHA256 hashes under outputs/validated_42_20260917/cases. Numerical trajectories remain reconstruction assumptions unless explicitly stated in the source.
rules: Keep all original 42 case IDs. The frozen signatures are historical selection metadata, not ground truth for the reconstructed incident.
Record which report participant is controlled by PCLA; do not silently equate the SUT with the report AV.
Separate physical collision sensor events from geometric overlaps and separate scripted reconstruction from autonomous PCLA outcomes.
Do not force an ADS collision by replacing its outputs, disabling its safety response or teleporting actors.
Retain multiple impacts and necessary third parties; disclose absent sensor pods, mirrors and bus bike racks when stock CARLA assets cannot represent them exactly.

cases.av: Waymo stopped southbound at a red light
cases.other: Toyota Camry approaches from behind
cases.source_quote: The Waymo AV was stopped in traffic for a red light
cases.legacy_risk: SUT is the striking passenger car, not the reported AV; avoidance is a valid ADS outcome.

cases.av: Waymo stops in a southbound traffic queue and remains stopped at red
cases.other: Honda Accord approaches from behind
cases.source_quote: the front of the passenger car made contact with the rear of the stationary Waymo AV
cases.legacy_risk: Do not model the AV as moving into a stationary lead vehicle without disclosing role reassignment.

cases.av: Zoox stopped northbound at red
cases.other: southbound Toyota SUV runs red and strikes an eastbound passenger car
required_events: SUV contacts stopped Zoox front driver side and driver side
cases.source_quote: The SUV spun after making contact with the passenger car and collided with the stopped Zoox vehicle
cases.legacy_risk: A single crossing NPC omits both a participant and the causal first collision.
cases.stock_asset_limitation: The PDF identifies Vehicle 2 as a Toyota SUV but gives no model. CARLA stock Nissan/Jeep/Audi SUV substitutes do not reproduce the actual Toyota asset.

cases.av: Waymo parked on right side of road in manual mode
cases.other: Honda Odyssey approaches from the AV left; same-direction passing is a reconstruction assumption
required_events: approaching vehicle contacts AV left mirror
cases.source_quote: The Waymo AV was parked on the right side of East 8th Street
cases.legacy_risk: Mirror geometry may require an explicit approximation; frontal impact is not equivalent.

cases.av: Waymo moves after a stop sign, then crosses next intersection and stops
cases.other: Tesla follows, runs stop sign, pushes AV, separates, then accelerates again
required_events: Tesla front right contacts AV rear left
cases.source_quote: The passenger car then accelerated and the front right corner of the passenger car made contact with the rear left corner of the stationary Waymo AV
cases.legacy_risk: Stopping the episode at the first collision loses the second impact.

cases.av: Zoox initially stopped in traffic, then follows departing traffic at low speed
cases.other: Nissan Frontier approaches from behind
cases.source_quote: When traffic ahead began to move the Zoox vehicle was appropriately following the car ahead at low speed
cases.legacy_risk: AV must move before impact; static rear-end is incomplete.

cases.av: Waymo northbound in rightmost of two lanes, partially enters left lane to give cyclist space
cases.other: heavy truck moves forward from behind in left lane; cyclist on AV right
required_events: AV rear driver side meets truck front passenger side
cases.source_quote: it partially entered the left adjacent lane to make room for a cyclist on its right
cases.legacy_risk: The AV changes lateral position; the truck is not the cut-in vehicle.

cases.av: Cruise westbound in left travel lane
cases.other: Honda starts behind in right lane, crosses AV lane into left parking lane and merges back
required_events: Honda merges right into AV lane
contact at AV front left quarter and mirror
cases.source_quote: The Honda Accord then began to merge back into the Cruise AV's lane
cases.legacy_risk: Preserve the left-side return cut-in and braking, not an arbitrary right-side cut-in.

cases.av: WeRide stationary in metering-light queue on freeway on-ramp
cases.other: BMW behind accelerates to about 5 MPH
cases.source_quote: While our car was stationary (0 MPH), the other car involved accelerated slightly to about 5 MPH
cases.legacy_risk: Preserve ramp context and source speed; highway-speed crash would be wrong.

cases.av: Waymo stopped in rightmost non-HOV lane at green waiting for junction to clear
cases.other: passenger car immediately behind AV; pickup behind passenger car
required_events: passenger car is pushed into stopped AV
cases.source_quote: The passenger car behind the Waymo AV was rear-ended by a pickup truck
cases.legacy_risk: Both physical contacts and the middle vehicle are required.

cases.av: Waymo travels west then stops to yield
cases.other: oncoming Toyota passes
required_events: passenger-car driver mirror contacts AV sensor
cases.source_quote: its driver side rearview mirror made contact with a Waymo AV sensor
cases.legacy_risk: Requires close lateral passage, not frontal impact or a static oncoming car.

cases.av: Waymo westbound preparing left turn, manual at impact
cases.other: passenger car overtakes AV and car behind it via opposing lane, in the same travel direction
required_events: overtaker enters opposing lane but travels same direction as AV
overtaker right side contacts AV front left
cases.source_quote: A passenger car passed the Waymo AV and the vehicle directly behind the Waymo AV by crossing into and driving in the opposing lane of traffic
cases.legacy_risk: Oncoming lane occupancy does not mean oncoming travel direction.

cases.av: Zoox westbound on Chess Drive
cases.other: parallel-parked Nissan suddenly leaves right parking space without yielding
required_events: Nissan enters AV lane from right
AV right front meets Nissan driver door/front wheel
cases.source_quote: abruptly entered the Zoox vehicle’s travel lane from a parking space in the right parking lane
cases.legacy_risk: A moving adjacent-lane NPC omits the parked-to-moving transition.

cases.av: Zoox southwest in lane 4
cases.other: Camaro ahead in right adjacent lane 5 goes around a cyclist then swerves left
required_events: Camaro driver quarter contacts AV passenger fender/front door
cases.source_quote:
Vehicle 2 then swerved left into
 lane 4 across the path of the Zoox vehicle
cases.legacy_risk: Preserve five-lane context and cyclist as causal participant.

cases.av: Zoox northeast on Folsom turning left onto 6th, manual
cases.other: Volkswagen southeast on 6th runs red
required_events: car front driver side contacts AV driver rear wheel
cases.source_quote: failed to stop for the red traffic light and entered the intersection
cases.legacy_risk: A head-on encounter or straight AV route misses contact geometry.

cases.av: Cruise southbound passes stopped eighteen-wheeler in right lane, then briefly stops while completing pass
cases.other: Dodge Charger comes from behind in left lane and passes AV on left
required_events: Dodge passes left and contacts AV front left region
cases.source_quote: The Cruise AV began to navigate around the eighteen-wheeler and stopped briefly as it was completing its passing maneuver
cases.legacy_risk: The truck is background obstruction, not the crash partner.

cases.av: Apollo westbound stops for double-parked Lexus, driver takes over and passes
cases.other: Lexus remains double parked
required_events: AV begins passing in manual mode
cases.source_quote: Then the AV side-swiped the double-parked vehicle while in conventional mode
cases.legacy_risk: Stationary obstacle plus braking alone cannot reproduce the reported later passage.

cases.av: Mercedes manual on curved interchange, stops after lead vehicle abruptly stops
cases.other: lead traffic vehicle and trailing Chevrolet
cases.source_quote: The vehicle behind him did not come to a stop in time and rear ended the Mercedes-Benz
cases.legacy_risk: Three narrative participants; the Mercedes is the middle vehicle, never autonomous during this incident.

cases.av: Cruise northbound decelerates for stop sign
cases.other: Ford Transit van fails to stop behind
cases.source_quote: As the Cruise AV was coming to a stop for a stop sign
cases.legacy_risk: Retain deceleration before impact; source does not say AV was stationary at impact.

cases.av: Waymo parked in lane with hazard lights after prior collision
cases.other: Tesla SUV approaches from behind and passes left
required_events: SUV passenger side contacts AV rear driver side
cases.source_quote: began to pass the Waymo AV on the left
cases.legacy_risk: The parked AV is struck during lateral passage, not rear-ended directly.

cases.av: Zoox creeps forward in manual mode while providing passing space
cases.other: oncoming truck
required_events: truck side contacts AV rear radar sensor
cases.source_quote: was slowly moving forward in response to an oncoming truck
cases.legacy_risk: Not head-on collision; truck dimensions matter.

cases.av: Zoox northeast stopped at red on Mission then inches forward on green
cases.other: bus southeast on 9th turns right onto Mission; rack protrudes on bus driver side
required_events: bus right turn into opposing direction
protruding bike rack contacts AV driver fender
cases.source_quote: a front-mounted triple-bike rack extending past the width of the bus on the driver's side
cases.legacy_risk: Stock bus hull is not an exact model of a protruding rack; disclose any asset approximation.

cases.av: Cruise southbound waits for oncoming traffic before left turn
cases.other: BMW contacts AV right rear; approach unspecified in narrative
required_events: contact at AV right rear corner
cases.source_quote:
waiting for oncoming traffic to clear the intersection
before making a left turn
cases.legacy_risk: Do not claim a precise lane change or approach direction as a reported fact.

cases.av: Waymo southwest left lane, stops in traffic queue
cases.other: Toyota Prius approaches behind
required_events: Prius front bumper contacts AV rear bumper
cases.source_quote: While the Waymo AV remained stationary, a passenger car approached the Waymo AV from behind
cases.legacy_risk: Static lead role reversal must be explicit.

cases.av: Waymo northwest stops to yield
cases.other: heavy truck southeast passes
required_events: truck driver side contacts AV rear driver sensor
cases.source_quote: a heavy truck traveling southeast on Randall Street
cases.legacy_risk: Legacy adjacent/static classification does not encode opposing passage.

cases.av: Zoox southbound yielding to pedestrian before right turn, manual
cases.other: large truck in left adjacent lane abruptly turns right
required_events: contact at AV left front sensor
cases.source_quote: A large truck in the left adjacent lane abruptly turned right and cut in front of the Zoox vehicle
cases.legacy_risk: Both turn paths and the pedestrian conflict should remain visible.

cases.av: Zoox slows to stop behind traffic
cases.other: Volvo hits from rear at approximately 10 MPH
cases.source_quote: a vehicle behind made contact at approximately 10mph
cases.legacy_risk: Do not substitute a high-speed crash for stated low-speed contact.

cases.av: Apple test vehicle makes right turn; driver takes over before collision
cases.other: Mazda3 contacts rear sensor
cases.source_quote:
This occurred as the test vehicle was making a right
turn
cases.legacy_risk: Requires a curved turn trajectory; stationary rear-end is not equivalent.

cases.av: Cruise eastbound through intersection
cases.other: Toyota changes into AV lane
required_events: contact at AV right front corner
cases.source_quote: another vehicle began to change into the Cruise AV’s lane
cases.legacy_risk: Source gives contact side but not a complete approach trajectory.

cases.av: Cruise stopped southbound at red
cases.other: passenger vehicle approaches behind
cases.source_quote: was at a complete stop in response to a red light
cases.legacy_risk: A static NPC in front is valid only with explicit SUT reassignment.

cases.av: Zoox eastbound stopped at stop sign preparing LEFT turn, manual
cases.other: Chevrolet makes wide RIGHT turn from side road toward westbound
cases.source_quote:
preparing to turn left onto
Treat Avenue

cases.av: Waymo northbound stationary in traffic queue

bus passenger side contacts AV rear driver side
cases.source_quote: a bus traveling directly behind the Waymo AV attempted to maneuver around the stopped Waymo AV
cases.legacy_risk: The bus, not the AV, overtakes; solid centerline violation is an observed incident behavior.

cases.av: Waymo stopped at unilluminated malfunctioning traffic light
cases.other: heavy truck initially stopped behind passes via opposing lane
required_events: truck passenger side contacts AV rear driver corner
cases.source_quote: the traffic light was not illuminated
cases.legacy_risk: Do not treat malfunctioning signal as an ordinary green light or eliminate the overtaking phase.

cases.av: Waymo stops at stop sign, creeps preparing merge, then manual stop
cases.other: Volvo behind rear-ends at approximately 7 MPH
cases.source_quote:
As the Waymo
AV proceeded slowly in preparation to merge
cases.legacy_risk: Requires stop-creep-stop sequence before low-speed rear contact.

cases.av: Waymo eastbound leftmost of two lanes enters intersection on yellow
cases.other: ambulance northbound makes right turn eastbound without lights/siren
required_events: ambulance right turn extends into left lane
ambulance front driver side contacts AV rear passenger door
cases.source_quote:
While the ambulance

cases.av: Waymo stopped southbound at red
cases.other: passenger car passes on right at approximately 1 MPH

cases.source_quote:
a passenger vehicle attempted to pass
the Waymo AV on the right

cases.source_quote: As the AV was yielding to oncoming traffic in preparation to make a left turn

required_events: AV remains stopped at red arrow
following car accelerates into AV rear
cases.source_quote: The left turn arrow signal for the dedicated turn lane occupied by the Waymo AV remained red
cases.legacy_risk: Preserve different permissions for turn lane and adjacent through lanes.

cases.av: Zoox straight through intersection at green, brakes after takeover

required_events: Nissan left turn into right of way
AV strikes Nissan right front corner
cases.source_quote: The Zoox vehicle struck the right front corner of vehicle 2

cases.av: Waymo southbound narrow road, slows and nudges right then stops at sign
cases.other: passenger car from AV right turns left into northbound opposing flow
required_events: other turns left from side road
turning car at about 5 MPH contacts AV driver rear sensor
cases.source_quote:
A passenger vehicle approaching from the right of the Waymo AV on eastbound
Thornton Avenue made a left turn in front of the Waymo AV
cases.legacy_risk: Not a static oncoming vehicle or an AV right turn.

cases.av: AutoX follows right curve at 16 MPH, driver takes over, passes too close to parking
cases.other: Honda parked at roadside
required_events: AV right sensor pod contacts parked car left mirror
cases.source_quote: The AV was making a right turn along the Kingsbury Cir, traveling at 16 mph

cases.av: Waymo eastbound waits for pedestrians and cyclist then manually turns right southbound
cases.other: cyclist approaches behind on sidewalk, continues east into crosswalk; pedestrians clear first
required_events: AV waits then begins right turn
cyclist contacts AV passenger rear quarter
